pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take:
**Rafe, are you even aware this isn't a FIFA video game?**

The Noisemaker's performance in this pool is nothing short of a disaster, and his draft picks scream pure chaos from a 15-year-old who clearly can't tell a corner kick from a goal kick. With Germany as his only serious pick, Rafe's been left dreaming of fantasy glory while stuck at the bottom with a paltry 29 points. At least Devin, aka Ghost Pepper, looks like he's played the game before, cruising in first place thanks to savvy choices like Spain and USA. Now, coming up in Miami Gardens, we have Bubba G’s France ready to dismantle Gayden’s England. This isn’t just a clash between European soccer giants; it's a showcase of Bubba G’s superior drafting might. Gayden’s England just fell to Argentina, exposing their vulnerability, while Gunner’s France is poised to exploit every little weakness. Mark my words: France will dominate, because unlike The Backpass Assassin, Bubba G actually understands that football isn’t just about playing it safe.
